NEH.P.12.1-26.text: The Priests and Levites Who Returned

NEH.1.1-2.text: Nehemiah asks Hanani about the Jews and Jerusalem

NEH.1.3-3.text: Nehemiah hears that Jerusalem’s wall is broken down

NEH.1.4-5.text: Nehemiah weeps, fasts and begins to pray to God

NEH.1.6-7.text: Nehemiah confesses the sins of Israel to God

NEH.1.8-9.text: Nehemiah asks God to remember the promise to Moses

NEH.1.10-11.text: Nehemiah prays that the king will show him mercy

NEH.2.1-2.text: The king sees that Nehemiah is sad

NEH.2.3-3.text: Nehemiah tells the king he is sad about Jerusalem

NEH.2.4-6.text: Nehemiah asks the king to send him to rebuild Jerusalem

NEH.2.7-8.text: The king gives Nehemiah letters and timber for the work

NEH.2.9-10.text: Sanballat and Tobiah are upset by Nehemiah’s coming

NEH.2.11-12.text: Nehemiah secretly goes out at night in Jerusalem

NEH.2.13-14.text: Nehemiah inspects the broken walls and gates at night

NEH.2.15-16.text: Nehemiah returns and has told no one his plan

NEH.2.17-18.text: Nehemiah urges the people to rebuild, and they agree

NEH.2.19-20.text: Enemies mock the builders; Nehemiah trusts God

NEH.3.1-2.text: Eliashib and the priests rebuild the Sheep Gate

NEH.3.3-5.text: The sons of Hassenaah and others rebuild the Fish Gate

NEH.3.6-7.text: Joiada and Meshullam repair the Jeshanah Gate

NEH.3.8-10.text: Uzziel, Hananiah and others repair the wall

NEH.3.11-12.text: Shallum and his daughters repair part of the wall

NEH.3.13-13.text: Hanun and the people of Zanoah repair the Valley Gate

NEH.3.14-15.text: Malchijah and Shallun repair the Dung and Fountain Gates

NEH.3.16-17.text: Levites and rulers repair the wall near David’s tombs

NEH.3.18-19.text: Binnui, Ezer and others repair more of the wall

NEH.3.20-21.text: Baruch and Meremoth repair the wall by Eliashib’s house

NEH.3.22-24.text: Priests, Benjamin and Azariah repair the wall

NEH.3.25-27.text: Palal, Pedaiah and the Tekoites repair more of the wall

NEH.3.28-30.text: Priests and others repair the wall near the Horse Gate

NEH.3.31-32.text: Goldsmiths and merchants repair the wall to the Sheep Gate

NEH.4.1-3.text: Sanballat and Tobiah mock the Jews who rebuild the wall

NEH.4.4-6.text: Nehemiah prays, and the people keep building the wall

NEH.4.7-8.text: Sanballat and others plan to fight against Jerusalem

NEH.4.9-9.text: Nehemiah and the people pray and set a guard

NEH.4.10-11.text: Judah is discouraged and enemies plan to attack

NEH.4.12-14.text: Nehemiah tells the people not to fear and to fight

NEH.4.15-16.text: Half of Nehemiah’s men work and half hold weapons

NEH.4.17-18.text: Nehemiah’s workers build with weapons ready

NEH.4.19-20.text: Nehemiah tells the people to gather when the horn sounds

NEH.4.21-23.text: Nehemiah’s people guard at night and work by day

NEH.5.1-3.text: Poor Jews cry out because of hunger and debt

NEH.5.4-5.text: Jews borrow for taxes and must sell children as slaves

NEH.5.6-8.text: Nehemiah angrily rebukes the nobles for charging interest

NEH.5.9-11.text: Nehemiah tells the nobles to return fields and homes

NEH.5.12-13.text: The nobles swear an oath to do as Nehemiah says

NEH.5.14-15.text: Nehemiah does not burden the people like earlier governors

NEH.5.16-17.text: Nehemiah works on the wall and feeds 150 at his table

NEH.5.18-19.text: Nehemiah gives up the governor’s food and asks God’s favor

NEH.6.1-2.text: Sanballat and Geshem invite Nehemiah to meet, planning harm

NEH.6.3-4.text: Nehemiah refuses four times to leave the work

NEH.6.5-6.text: Sanballat falsely says Nehemiah plans to become king

NEH.6.7-7.text: Sanballat threatens to tell the king and asks to meet

NEH.6.8-9.text: Nehemiah denies the rumors and asks God for strength

NEH.6.10-11.text: Nehemiah refuses Shemaiah’s advice to hide in the temple

NEH.6.12-14.text: Nehemiah sees that Tobiah and Sanballat hired Shemaiah

NEH.6.15-16.text: The wall is finished in 52 days and enemies are afraid

NEH.6.17-19.text: Tobiah exchanges letters with the nobles of Judah

NEH.7.1-2.text: Nehemiah appoints Hanani and Hananiah to lead Jerusalem

NEH.7.3-3.text: Nehemiah gives orders about opening the city gates

NEH.7.4-4.text: Jerusalem is large, but few people live there

NEH.7.5-5.text: Nehemiah decides to register the people by family

NEH.7.6-7.text: Nehemiah lists the people who returned from Babylon

NEH.7.8-10.text: Returning families of Parosh, Shephatiah and Arah

NEH.7.11-14.text: Returning families of Pahath-moab, Elam, Zattu and Zaccai

NEH.7.15-18.text: Returning families of Binnui, Bebai, Azgad and Adonikam

NEH.7.19-22.text: Returning families of Bigvai, Adin, Ater and Hashum

NEH.7.23-26.text: Returning families of Bezai, Hariph, Gibeon and Bethlehem

NEH.7.27-30.text: The numbers of men from Anathoth and other towns who returned

NEH.7.31-34.text: The numbers of men from Michmash, Bethel and other places

NEH.7.35-38.text: The numbers from Harim, Jericho, Lod and Senaah

NEH.7.39-42.text: The numbers of priests who returned

NEH.7.43-45.text: The numbers of Levites, singers and gatekeepers

NEH.7.46-49.text: The first families of temple servants who returned

NEH.7.50-52.text: More families of temple servants who returned

NEH.7.53-56.text: The last families of temple servants who returned

NEH.7.57-60.text: The families of Solomon’s servants and the total number

NEH.7.61-63.text: Some families could not prove they came from Israel

NEH.7.64-65.text: Priests without family records are barred from the priesthood

NEH.7.66-67.text: The total number of people, servants and singers

NEH.7.68-69.text: The numbers of horses, mules, camels and donkeys

NEH.7.70-72.text: The governor and the people give gifts for the work

NEH.7.73-73.text: The priests and the people settle in their towns

NEH.8.1-3.text: Ezra reads the Law to the people at the Water Gate

NEH.8.4-5.text: Ezra stands on a platform and the people stand up

NEH.8.6-8.text: The people worship and the Levites explain the Law

NEH.8.9-10.text: Nehemiah tells the people not to weep but to feast

NEH.8.11-12.text: The Levites calm the people, who eat and rejoice

NEH.8.13-15.text: Leaders find the command to live in booths

NEH.8.16-17.text: The people make booths and celebrate with great joy

NEH.8.18-18.text: Ezra reads the Law daily during the seven-day feast

NEH.9.1-2.text: The Israelites fast and confess their sins

NEH.9.3-4.text: The people read the Law and the Levites cry out to God

NEH.9.5-6.text: The Levites call the people to bless God the Creator

NEH.9.7-8.text: The Levites remember God’s covenant with Abraham

NEH.9.9-10.text: The Levites remember how God saved Israel from Egypt

NEH.9.11-11.text: The Levites remember God dividing the sea

NEH.9.12-13.text: The Levites remember God’s guidance and the laws at Sinai

NEH.9.14-15.text: The Levites remember the Sabbath, bread and water from God

NEH.9.16-17.text: Israel’s fathers disobeyed, but God forgave them

NEH.9.18-19.text: God did not leave Israel even after the calf idol

NEH.9.20-21.text: God cared for Israel in the wilderness for forty years

NEH.9.22-22.text: God gave Israel kingdoms and the land of Sihon and Og

NEH.9.23-24.text: God gave Israel many descendants and the promised land

NEH.9.25-25.text: Israel took strong cities and enjoyed God’s goodness

NEH.9.26-27.text: Israel rebelled and killed prophets; God sent deliverers

NEH.9.28-29.text: Israel did evil again, and God saved Israel many times

NEH.9.30-31.text: God was patient and did not destroy Israel

NEH.9.32-34.text: The people say God is just and Israel has sinned

NEH.9.35-35.text: Israel did not serve God even in a good land

NEH.9.36-37.text: The people are slaves in the land God gave Israel

NEH.9.38-38.text: The people make a written agreement, sealed by leaders

NEH.10.1-3.text: Nehemiah and others sign the agreement

NEH.10.9-14.text: Levites and leaders of the people sign the agreement

NEH.10.15-21.text: More leaders of the people sign the agreement

NEH.10.22-27.text: The last leaders sign the agreement

NEH.10.28-29.text: The people swear an oath to obey God’s law

NEH.10.30-31.text: The people vow not to intermarry and to keep the Sabbath

NEH.10.32-33.text: The people promise a yearly gift for the temple service

NEH.10.34-36.text: The people promise wood and the first of crops and animals

NEH.10.37-38.text: The people promise tithes to the Levites and priests

NEH.10.39-39.text: The people promise not to neglect God’s house

NEH.11.1-2.text: Leaders and one in ten people settle in Jerusalem

NEH.11.3-4.text: Settlers from Judah live in Jerusalem

NEH.11.5-6.text: More men from Judah settle in Jerusalem

NEH.11.13-14.text: More priests who settle in Jerusalem

NEH.11.15-16.text: Levites who lead the work outside the temple

NEH.11.17-18.text: Other Levites in Jerusalem, 284 in all

NEH.11.20-21.text: Others live in Judah’s villages and on Ophel

NEH.11.22-24.text: Uzzi leads the Levites and Pethahiah serves the king

NEH.11.25-27.text: Some people of Judah lived in towns and villages

NEH.11.28-36.text: People of Judah and Benjamin settled in other towns

NEH.12.1-3.text: These priests came back with Zerubbabel and Jeshua

NEH.12.4-7.text: These were the leaders of the priests in Jeshua’s time

NEH.12.8-9.text: Levites led the songs of thanksgiving

NEH.12.10-11.text: Jeshua’s family line down to Jaddua

NEH.12.12-14.text: Heads of priestly families in the days of Joiakim

NEH.12.15-21.text: More heads of priestly families in Joiakim’s days

NEH.12.22-23.text: Priests and Levites were recorded in the days of Darius

NEH.12.24-26.text: Levites praised God and guarded the storerooms

NEH.12.27-28.text: Levites and singers come to Jerusalem for the dedication

NEH.12.29-30.text: Priests and Levites purify the people, gates and wall

NEH.12.31-31.text: Nehemiah puts two thanksgiving choirs on the wall

NEH.12.32-35.text: Leaders and priests with trumpets follow the first choir

NEH.12.36-37.text: Ezra leads the first choir to the Water Gate

NEH.12.38-39.text: Nehemiah follows the second choir along the wall

NEH.12.40-42.text: Both choirs and the leaders stand in the house of God

NEH.12.43-43.text: The people offer sacrifices and rejoice in Jerusalem

NEH.12.44-45.text: Men are appointed over the storerooms for the offerings

NEH.12.46-47.text: All Israel gave daily portions to singers and gatekeepers

NEH.13.4-5.text: Eliashib gave Tobiah a large room in the temple

NEH.13.6-7.text: Nehemiah returns and finds the evil Eliashib did

NEH.13.8-9.text: Nehemiah throws Tobiah’s goods out and purifies the rooms

NEH.13.10-11.text: Nehemiah rebukes the officials and restores the Levites

NEH.13.12-14.text: Judah brings tithes and Nehemiah appoints treasurers

NEH.13.15-15.text: Nehemiah warns people who work and sell on the Sabbath

NEH.13.16-18.text: Nehemiah rebukes the nobles for breaking the Sabbath

NEH.13.19-20.text: Nehemiah has the gates shut during the Sabbath

NEH.13.21-22.text: Nehemiah warns the merchants and sets Levites at the gates

NEH.13.23-24.text: Some Jews married foreign women from nearby peoples

NEH.13.25-27.text: Nehemiah rebukes the men and forbids foreign marriages

NEH.13.28-29.text: Nehemiah drives away a son of the high priest

NEH.13.30-31.text: Nehemiah purifies priests and Levites and sets duties
